about: Hand-maintained verified layer of the nsq schema graph. Generic NetSuite facts only: every entry was checked with a live read-only SuiteQL probe or comes from nsq's references (schema.md, chaining.md, dialect.md). On conflict these win over the Records Catalog. Edited by hand, then folded into graph.json by `nsq schema build`.

transactionaccountingline.label: Transaction Accounting Line
traps: One row per posting line per accounting book: always filter accountingbook or multi-book accounts double.
No item column: the item is on transactionline.item.
Signed amount: NVL(debit,0) - NVL(credit,0). Filter posting = 'T' here and on transaction.
Debit and credit are in the posting subsidiary's base currency: never add across subsidiaries with different currencies.

aggregateitemlocation.label: Aggregate Item Location
traps: One row per item and location: always filter item IN (...) or it fans out across every location.
Per-location average cost lives here (averagecostmli); item.averagecost is a company-wide blend.
Standard-cost items: averagecostmli shows the standard, not an average.
lastpurchasepricemli has no link back to a transaction.

inventoryassignment.label: Inventory Assignment (lot, serial, bin detail)
traps: quantity is signed: negative when the line takes units out of a lot, positive when it puts them in.
A lot can have several making documents: a join to the maker repeats the consuming row once per maker.

nexttransactionlink.label: Next Transaction Link (header level)
traps: Header level with exactly three columns: no amount. Never present the applying document's total as the amount applied.
previoustransactionlink returns the same rows.

previoustransactionlink.label: Previous Transaction Link (same rows as nexttransactionlink)
traps: Same rows as nexttransactionlink.

nexttransactionlinelink.label: Next Transaction Line Link (line level)
traps: previousline and nextline are transactionline.id values, not linesequencenumber.

bomrevisioncomponentmember.label: BOM Revision Component Member
traps: Component quantity is in the line's unit (units), not the item's base unit: convert with unitstypeuom.conversionrate.
bomrevisioncomponent also exists; systemnote refers to that one.

itemassemblyitembom.label: Assembly Item BOM link
traps: An assembly can have several BOMs: pick one deterministically (location default, then masterdefault, then lowest id).

manufacturingroutingroutingstep.label: Manufacturing Routing Step
traps: Work center and cost template are on the step, not the routing: one routing can span several work centers.
runrate units are unresolved: confirm against the UI before using it in math.

itemvendor.label: Item Vendor (vendor, price per subsidiary)
traps: One row per item, vendor and subsidiary: filter preferredvendor = 'T' for the preferred vendor. item.vendor holds only the preferred vendor, no price.

transaction: createdfrom is not a transaction column (UNEXPECTED_ERROR): use transactionline.createdfrom.
Location and subsidiary for posting lines are on transactionline; the header location can be empty.
Status: SuiteQL returns the short code ('D'); filter both forms, IN ('D','WorkOrd:D').
recordtype is the lower-case record name (invoice, itemfulfillment, workorderissue); type is the short code (CustInvc, ItemShip, WOIssue).
Periods: join accountingperiod on postingperiod and filter accountingperiod.enddate, not trandate.
transactionline: mainline = 'T' is the header line; on a work order completion the finished-good receipt is the mainline row.
mainline = 'F' still leaves tax lines: add taxline = 'F'.
quantity and rate are in the item's base unit whatever units says; BUILTIN.DF(units) is a label only.
Sales order and invoice line quantity and amount are negative; credit memo lines positive.
Landed-cost lines have NULL quantity and landedcostcategory set.
COGS posts on the item fulfillment (iscogs = 'T' lines), not the invoice.
item: averagecost is a company-wide blend: per-location cost is aggregateitemlocation.
matrixtype = 'PARENT' marks a grouping item with no BOM: exclude it when listing assemblies.
bomrevision: An as-of date must fall inside effectivestartdate..effectiveenddate or you get zero rows; null bounds are open-ended.
Overlapping revisions are possible: keep the latest effectivestartdate, then the highest id.
unitstypeuom: The unit key is internalid; unit ids are per units type. conversionrate converts to the base unit.
accountingperiod: Filter on enddate; isadjust = 'F' excludes adjustment periods. Balance-sheet balances take no start date.
account: Use accountsearchdisplayname for the name and accttype (e.g. COGS) for the type.
systemnote: Audit trail: needs a narrow date window; no GROUP BY; constants in SELECT fail.
location: No address columns: join locationmainaddress on nkey = location.mainaddress.
manufacturingcosttemplatecostdetail: runrate and fixedrate are different units: total them separately, never sum them together.
consolidatedexchangerate: One row per from/to subsidiary, posting period and accounting book: join all four (fromsubsidiary, tosubsidiary = subsidiary.parent, postingperiod, accountingbook) or rows multiply. The top-level subsidiary has no parent row.

edges.label: Created From (source document)
traps: createdfrom is on the line, never on transaction.
Keyed share varies: inventory documents are usually fully keyed, journals never, revaluations partly. Measure it before relying on it.
Fallback when blank: nexttransactionlink (header level).

edges.label: Transaction Line
traps: Join on both keys and on transactionline.id, never linesequencenumber: they usually agree, so the wrong key passes casual tests and lands on another item where they differ.
Always filter accountingbook.

edges.label: Posting Period
traps: Filter accountingperiod.enddate, not transaction.trandate.

edges.label: Transfer order destination location
traps: Destination location is only on the transfer order header; the source location is on the posting lines.

edges.label: Transaction Line
traps: Join on both keys; transactionline is transactionline.id, not linesequencenumber.

edges.label: Transaction
traps: Header level: lot rows belong to specific lines. Join transactionline on both keys to keep the line grain.

edges.label: Lot or serial number
traps: inventorynumber.inventorynumber is the lot name.

edges.label: Assembly
traps: assembly is the built item; the components are on bomrevisioncomponentmember.item.

edges.label: BOM Revision
traps: Pick the revision effective on the as-of date first, or every revision's components come back.

edges.label: Component item
traps: This is the component item (where-used). For an assembly's components go item -> itemassemblyitembom -> bom -> bomrevision -> bomrevisioncomponentmember.

edges.label: Ship-to address
traps: Address tables key on nkey, not id.

edges.label: Bill-to address
traps: Address tables key on nkey, not id.

chains.name: invoice-to-shipped-lots
chains.about: Lots shipped for an invoice: invoice lines -> sales order (createdfrom) -> fulfillment lines -> lot detail.
chains.sql:
FROM transaction inv
JOIN transactionline il ON il.transaction = inv.id AND il.mainline = 'F' AND il.item IS NOT NULL
JOIN transactionline fl ON fl.createdfrom = il.createdfrom AND fl.item = il.item
JOIN transaction f ON f.id = fl.transaction AND f.type = 'ItemShip'
JOIN inventoryassignment ia ON ia.transaction = fl.transaction AND ia.transactionline = fl.id AND ia.quantity < 0
JOIN inventorynumber inum ON inum.id = ia.inventorynumber
WHERE inv.type = 'CustInvc' AND inv.id = :invoice
traps: Invoices carry no lot detail: lots are on the fulfillment lines of the same sales order.
Fan-out: a sales order with several fulfillments or invoices attaches every fulfillment's lots to each invoice line of that item. Match by quantity or date if you need one-to-one.
Shipped quantity is -ia.quantity; inum.inventorynumber is the lot name.
chains.probe: SELECT inv.id, il.item, inum.inventorynumber, ia.quantity FROM transaction inv JOIN transactionline il ON il.transaction = inv.id AND il.mainline = 'F' AND il.item IS NOT NULL JOIN transactionline fl ON fl.createdfrom = il.createdfrom AND fl.item = il.item JOIN transaction f ON f.id = fl.transaction AND f.type = 'ItemShip' JOIN inventoryassignment ia ON ia.transaction = fl.transaction AND ia.transactionline = fl.id AND ia.quantity < 0 JOIN inventorynumber inum ON inum.id = ia.inventorynumber WHERE inv.type = 'CustInvc' AND ROWNUM <= 5

chains.name: gl-line-to-source
chains.about: GL line to its line, item, location and source document (createdfrom), primary book, posted.
chains.sql:
FROM transactionaccountingline tal
JOIN accountingbook ab ON ab.id = tal.accountingbook AND ab.isprimary = 'T'
JOIN transaction t ON t.id = tal.transaction
JOIN transactionline tl ON tl.transaction = tal.transaction AND tl.id = tal.transactionline
LEFT JOIN transaction src ON src.id = tl.createdfrom
WHERE tal.posting = 'T' AND t.posting = 'T'
traps: tl.id = tal.transactionline, never linesequencenumber.
Keep lines with no createdfrom (journals) as their own bucket; LEFT JOIN, never drop them.
Signed amount: NVL(tal.debit,0) - NVL(tal.credit,0).
chains.probe: SELECT tal.account, NVL(tal.debit,0) - NVL(tal.credit,0) AS amount, tl.item, tl.location, src.id, src.type, src.tranid FROM transactionaccountingline tal JOIN accountingbook ab ON ab.id = tal.accountingbook AND ab.isprimary = 'T' JOIN transaction t ON t.id = tal.transaction JOIN transactionline tl ON tl.transaction = tal.transaction AND tl.id = tal.transactionline LEFT JOIN transaction src ON src.id = tl.createdfrom WHERE tal.posting = 'T' AND t.posting = 'T' AND ROWNUM <= 5

chains.name: assembly-bom-as-of
chains.about: Single-level components of an assembly effective on a date: itemassemblyitembom -> bomrevision (as-of window) -> bomrevisioncomponentmember.
chains.sql:
FROM (SELECT br.id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY br.effectivestartdate DESC, br.id DESC) rn
      FROM itemassemblyitembom iab
      JOIN bomrevision br ON br.billofmaterials = iab.billofmaterials
      WHERE iab.assembly = :item AND iab.masterdefault = 'T'
        AND (br.effectivestartdate IS NULL OR br.effectivestartdate <= :asof)
        AND (br.effectiveenddate IS NULL OR br.effectiveenddate >= :asof)) r
JOIN bomrevisioncomponentmember bcm ON bcm.bomrevision = r.id
WHERE r.rn = 1
traps: An as-of date outside every revision window returns zero rows.
masterdefault picks the master BOM; for a location's BOM use defaultforlocation first.
bcm.quantity is in bcm.units, not the component's base unit.
A work order's actual recipe is transaction.billofmaterialsrevision, not the as-of revision.
chains.probe: SELECT bcm.item, bcm.quantity, bcm.units, r.id FROM (SELECT br.id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY br.effectivestartdate DESC, br.id DESC) rn FROM itemassemblyitembom iab JOIN bomrevision br ON br.billofmaterials = iab.billofmaterials WHERE iab.assembly = (SELECT MAX(assembly) FROM itemassemblyitembom WHERE masterdefault = 'T') AND iab.masterdefault = 'T' AND (br.effectivestartdate IS NULL OR br.effectivestartdate <= SYSDATE) AND (br.effectiveenddate IS NULL OR br.effectiveenddate >= SYSDATE)) r JOIN bomrevisioncomponentmember bcm ON bcm.bomrevision = r.id WHERE r.rn = 1 AND ROWNUM <= 5

chains.name: work-order-documents
chains.about: Issues, completions, closes and unbuilds of a work order through transactionline.createdfrom.
chains.sql:
FROM transaction wo
JOIN transactionline x ON x.createdfrom = wo.id
JOIN transaction d ON d.id = x.transaction
 AND d.recordtype IN ('workorderissue','workordercompletion','workorderclose','assemblyunbuild')
WHERE wo.type = 'WorkOrd' AND wo.id = :workorder
traps: Without the recordtype filter this also pulls whole revaluations keyed to the work order.
Completion lines with transactionlinetype = 'ROUTINGITEM' carry labor and overhead.
One row per line: aggregate or DISTINCT d.id for one row per document.
chains.probe: SELECT wo.id, d.id, d.recordtype, x.id FROM transaction wo JOIN transactionline x ON x.createdfrom = wo.id JOIN transaction d ON d.id = x.transaction AND d.recordtype IN ('workorderissue','workordercompletion','workorderclose','assemblyunbuild') WHERE wo.type = 'WorkOrd' AND ROWNUM <= 5

chains.name: lot-maker
chains.about: Which completion (and work order) made a lot: positive inventoryassignment on the completion's mainline.
chains.sql:
FROM inventoryassignment ia
JOIN transactionline ml ON ml.transaction = ia.transaction AND ml.id = ia.transactionline AND ml.mainline = 'T'
JOIN transaction c ON c.id = ml.transaction AND c.recordtype = 'workordercompletion'
WHERE ia.quantity > 0 AND ia.inventorynumber = :lot
-- ml.createdfrom is the work order
traps: Keep the maker restrictions inside one subquery when joining to consuming rows; chained LEFT JOINs keep receipts and adjustments and duplicate rows.
A lot can have several makers, later receipts, or an opening adjustment as its origin.
chains.probe: SELECT ia.inventorynumber, c.id, ml.createdfrom FROM inventoryassignment ia JOIN transactionline ml ON ml.transaction = ia.transaction AND ml.id = ia.transactionline AND ml.mainline = 'T' JOIN transaction c ON c.id = ml.transaction AND c.recordtype = 'workordercompletion' WHERE ia.quantity > 0 AND ROWNUM <= 5

chains.name: invoice-to-cogs
chains.about: COGS for what an invoice sold: posts on the fulfillment's iscogs lines, not on the invoice.
chains.sql:
FROM transaction inv
JOIN transactionline il ON il.transaction = inv.id AND il.mainline = 'F' AND il.item IS NOT NULL
JOIN transactionline fl ON fl.createdfrom = il.createdfrom AND fl.item = il.item AND fl.iscogs = 'T'
JOIN transaction f ON f.id = fl.transaction AND f.type = 'ItemShip'
JOIN transactionaccountingline tal ON tal.transaction = fl.transaction AND tal.transactionline = fl.id
JOIN account a ON a.id = tal.account AND a.accttype = 'COGS'
JOIN accountingbook ab ON ab.id = tal.accountingbook AND ab.isprimary = 'T'
WHERE inv.type = 'CustInvc' AND inv.id = :invoice
traps: Several fulfillments per sales order: map invoice line to fulfillment line, do not attach all of them to every invoice line.
Per-unit COGS times invoiced quantity when invoices and fulfillments do not match one-to-one.
chains.probe: SELECT inv.id, fl.transaction, tal.account, NVL(tal.debit,0) - NVL(tal.credit,0) AS cogs FROM transaction inv JOIN transactionline il ON il.transaction = inv.id AND il.mainline = 'F' AND il.item IS NOT NULL JOIN transactionline fl ON fl.createdfrom = il.createdfrom AND fl.item = il.item AND fl.iscogs = 'T' JOIN transaction f ON f.id = fl.transaction AND f.type = 'ItemShip' JOIN transactionaccountingline tal ON tal.transaction = fl.transaction AND tal.transactionline = fl.id JOIN account a ON a.id = tal.account AND a.accttype = 'COGS' JOIN accountingbook ab ON ab.id = tal.accountingbook AND ab.isprimary = 'T' WHERE inv.type = 'CustInvc' AND ROWNUM <= 5

chains.name: gl-line-consolidated-rate
chains.about: Consolidated exchange rates that translate a GL line's subsidiary into its parent for the posting period and book.
chains.sql:
FROM transactionaccountingline tal
JOIN accountingbook ab ON ab.id = tal.accountingbook AND ab.isprimary = 'T'
JOIN transaction t ON t.id = tal.transaction
JOIN transactionline tl ON tl.transaction = tal.transaction AND tl.id = tal.transactionline
JOIN subsidiary s ON s.id = tl.subsidiary
JOIN consolidatedexchangerate cer ON cer.fromsubsidiary = tl.subsidiary AND cer.tosubsidiary = s.parent
 AND cer.postingperiod = t.postingperiod AND cer.accountingbook = tal.accountingbook
WHERE tal.posting = 'T' AND t.posting = 'T'
traps: All four keys or the rate row multiplies.
Lines of the top-level subsidiary have no parent rate: LEFT JOIN to keep them.
chains.probe: SELECT tal.transaction, cer.averagerate FROM transactionaccountingline tal JOIN accountingbook ab ON ab.id = tal.accountingbook AND ab.isprimary = 'T' JOIN transaction t ON t.id = tal.transaction JOIN transactionline tl ON tl.transaction = tal.transaction AND tl.id = tal.transactionline JOIN subsidiary s ON s.id = tl.subsidiary JOIN consolidatedexchangerate cer ON cer.fromsubsidiary = tl.subsidiary AND cer.tosubsidiary = s.parent AND cer.postingperiod = t.postingperiod AND cer.accountingbook = tal.accountingbook WHERE tal.posting = 'T' AND ROWNUM <= 5
